entry.description: All-base finite-level bases for the totient kernel. The primary source reports: For integer base k>=2 and level e, the source reports a basis of the sections phi(k^j*n+r) through level e with dimension k^e+1, and integral-relation rank sum_(1<=j<e)k^j. Retained residues satisfy k not dividing r, not necessarily coprimality. Direct AI connection: Will Cook’s matched repository README explicitly attributes mathematical exploration, proof search and formalization to AI assistance under human direction. Further checking: Read the retained-channel normal form against the frozen source and compare Martin/Coons prior results. The classical affine-independence or nonregularity statements are not new; Erdős249 irrationality remains open. Official verification is commit-specific and not replayed here. No downloaded proof artifact was executed. Retain provisional=1, low strict confidence, taxonomy unreviewed and no strict Superhuman override.

entry.description: A repaired combinatorial double-sieve inequality in Wu2008 and Li2024. The primary source reports: The source reports repairing the last triple-sum range in Wu2008 Lemma2.2 and Li2024 Lemma3.1 to N^kappa2<=p4<N^(1/2−3kappa1), with the stated sieve-set corrections and explicit error4N/(N^kappa1−1) for A={N−p}. The resulting finite-count inequality holds for every N>1 under the listed admissibility hypotheses. The analytic sieve evaluations and downstream0.899 constant are not proved or corrected here. Direct AI connection: Steve Hubbard explicitly states that a ClaudeOpus5.5 agent found the gap while formalizing, wrote the repaired statement and all Lean code, with human publication direction and separate AI statement auditors. Further checking: Ask the original authors or an independent sieve specialist to check the altered range, sifted sets, error and weakened boundary hypothesis. The printed pointwise-counterexample test is outside this selected proof closure; do not infer a disproof of the final Goldbach or Chen bounds. No human expert review or independent artifact replay is claimed. Keep provisional=1, low strict confidence, taxonomy unreviewed and no strict Superhuman override.
